question: What textual division concludes the treatment of kūṭa, koṣṭha, and related marks?
premises: The statement is placed in the Aṃśumatkāśyapa text.
The subject is the marks of kūṭa, koṣṭha, and so on.
The division is identified as the thirtieth chapter.
inference: This concludes the thirtieth chapter on the characteristics of kūṭa, koṣṭha, and related elements in the Aṃśumatkāśyapa.
plain_english: Thus ends the thirtieth chapter, on the characteristics of kūṭa, koṣṭha, and so forth, in the Aṃśumatkāśyapa.
